topic: Rendered production layout of the redesigned shopping board (read-only GET, no login or checkout)
method: Headless Chrome 154 via scripts/browser-research.mjs; read-only page load, viewport measurements and screenshots. No cart, login or personal data.
toolingLimitation: The available file-read tool rejects PNG input ('reading images is not supported'), so the screenshots could not be machine-inspected by the model. The review below is based on rendered layout measurements and DOM text; the screenshots are artifacts for a human reviewer.

desktop1440.note: The owner-reported defect had a 2289 px comparison table inside a 1325 px container with 'Delivered total' starting at x=1641. The redesigned page has no table; the delivered-total cell ends at x=1290 inside the 1440 px viewport.

mobile390.note: No horizontal scrolling; the three decision values stack inside the viewport. The three pickup rows are grouped in the pickup-only section instead of being repeated on every offer card. Production currently shows two unknown cards (Pucks and the CoffeeMan 8-pack) because the stored observations predate the researched rates; they will rank after the next per-vendor refresh.
